description: Run content gap analysis for a URL and keyword. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Required.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

scrape_depth.description: Deepest heading level to include when comparing scraped page outlines. Type: String. Accepted values: "h1", "h2", "h3". Default: "h3".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

url.description: Absolute web page URL to analyze; use an http:// or https:// URL. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

name: agentseo_content_gap
title: AgentSEO Content Gap
